biological_interpretation: ADARB1 has an editing-independent or GRIA2-independent effect on FLNB expression in a limited neuronal subset.
caveats: The dataset measures mRNA abundance, not Flnb editing; recurrent down-regulation does not prove that FLNB editing directly controls Flnb transcript stability in neurons.

Exact log2 fold changes, scores, p-values, and FDRs in exact_de_rows were re-read from the Wilcoxon Parquet; the graph and cluster summaries were used only to nominate the target/readout combinations.
exact_observed_result: Adarb1 perturbation produced a recurring Flnb abundance decrease, strongest in selected posterior, hypothalamic, thalamic, and GABAergic classes, and this decrease was not reproduced by Adar or Gria2 perturbation in matched engaged classes. Parquet-verified leading rows: Adarb1->Flnb in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut log2FC -1.48, FDR 6.67e-44; Adarb1->Flnb in 145 MH-LH TH Glut log2FC -1.2, FDR 6.89e-15; Adarb1->Flnb in 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA log2FC -0.913, FDR 6.36e-11; Adarb1->Adarb1 in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut log2FC -0.555, FDR 2.04e-09; Adarb1->Flnb in 052 Pvalb Gaba log2FC -0.797, FDR 2.44e-08; Adarb1->Flna in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut log2FC -0.833, FDR 9.40e-07.

citations.citation: Altaf F, Vesely C, Sheikh AM, Munir R, Shah STA, Tariq A. Modulation of ADAR mRNA expression in patients with congenital heart defects. PLoS ONE. 2019;14:e0200968.
citations.description: Accessible study and literature synthesis noting ADAR2-mediated Q/R editing of FLNA and FLNB and testing FLNB editing and expression in ADAR2-deficient mouse heart.

prior_expectation.summary: References were retained only when they were linked to one of the resolved source findings.

finding_summaries.summary: Flnb is a recurrently down-regulated abundance marker of Adarb1 perturbation across neuronal classes.
finding_summaries.why_it_matters: The dominant RNA-seq response points to a filamin/actin-associated transcript rather than to the classical glutamate- or serotonin-receptor substrates, suggesting that Flnb abundance is the most sensitive measured downstream readout of ADAR2 loss in this atlas.

resolved_evidence.description: Flnb was the most recurrent abundance response to Adarb1 perturbation.
resolved_evidence.statistics: Flnb logFC was <0 in 22/22 Adarb1 tests; 21/22 nominal p<0.05; 12/22 FDR<0.05; 13/22 FDR<0.1; mean logFC -0.842; strongest FDR 6.67e-44.

resolved_evidence.description: Large Flnb decreases were concentrated in thalamic, midbrain, pons/medulla, hypothalamic, and Pvalb GABA classes.
resolved_evidence.statistics: Flnb was strongly down in 155 MB Glut, logFC -1.654 FDR 1.57e-38; 191 MB P MY GABA, -1.477 FDR 7.81e-16; 145 MH-LH TH Glut, -1.198 FDR 6.89e-15; 217 P MY Pineal Glut, -1.557 FDR 3.18e-11 with 35 perturbed cells; 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA, -0.913 FDR 6.36e-11; and 052 Pvalb Gaba, -0.797 FDR 2.44e-08.

resolved_evidence.description: The Flnb response extended beyond the strongest posterior brain groups to cortical, hippocampal, basal-ganglia, hypothalamic, and cerebellar groups.
resolved_evidence.statistics: Additional Flnb decreases were significant in 005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut, logFC -0.693 FDR 2.52e-05; 054 CNU-MGE GABA, -0.850 FDR 1.38e-04; 110 CNU-HYa HY MM Glut, -0.912 FDR 1.57e-04; 012 MEA LA CA1 DG Glut, -0.890 FDR 0.0276; and 308 CB GABA, -0.738 FDR 0.0218; 007 L2-3 IT CTX Glut was nominal at FDR 0.0799.

title: Adarb1 perturbation selectively lowers Flnb across posterior, hypothalamic, and GABAergic neuronal contexts
